verdict.rationale: WorkOS is an identity and auth platform with a dashboard, so in-product AI insights are a fair axis, but the evidence pack documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. The official MCP server lets external AI agents read and change workspace data. That is a building block for agents running outside WorkOS, not an in-product insights feature, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
